image_description: A large, realistic red mushroom with white spots (resembling Amanita muscaria) stands centrally against a white background. Arranged in a row at the base of the mushroom stem are four backpacks: one dark blue/tan on the far left, one red/beige, one green/blue, and one solid dark blue on the far right. The mushroom cap looms over the backpacks, but the backpacks are positioned side-by-side in front of the stem rather than physically underneath the cap's overhang.
